summary: PGIM Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K announcing regular monthly distributions for Class S, D, and I shares ($0.19506, $0.20732, and $0.21243 per share, respectively) payable July 27, 2026, to holders of record June 30, 2026, with cash or DRIP reinvestment. The filing also discloses May 31, 2026 NAVs per class, aggregate NAV of $277.5 million, portfolio value of $413.5 million, and $143.9 million in debt. It updates the ongoing $2.5 billion continuous public offering plus a private offering. This is a routine operational and disclosure update, not a special situation event.
